board.name: Startale Group
board.content: Startale Group is a leading global crypto solutions provider on a mission to build the next civilization by bringing the world onchain. The company co-develops Soneium, an Ethereum Layer 2 blockchain, through a joint venture with Sony Group Corporation, and partners with SBI Holdings on Strium, a Layer 1 blockchain for tokenized securities and RWA trading. Startale also drives JPYSC, the first trust bank-backed JPY stablecoin and powers onchain finance through USDSC, its USD stablecoin. Rounding out its product ecosystem, the Startale App brings it all together as a SuperApp for managing assets, accessing applications and navigating the onchain economy, all in one intuitive experience.
